page.layout: One block of running text, full width, with inline numbered items and inline references. No marginal notes, no catchword, no signature. Running head at top, page number at top right.

main_text.p: neque passum, neque crucifixum volunt: sed phantasma pro eo Iudæis esse oblatū, quod illi delusi pro Christo in cruce fixerūt. Manichæa-num & Marcioniticum istud. Azoa.ii. 8 Diabolos tandem salutem consequuturos, cum O-rigenistis docent. 9 Vitam æternam, Epicu-reorum more, in voluptatibus corporis, etiam in cælo collocant, cum Cerinthianis. Azoa. 23. 10 Infernum & pœnas inferni fabulosè expli-cant, ad modum inferni Vergiliani, Purgatorii-que Papistici. Azoa.21, & 25. 11 Legis cere-monias, imprimis circuncisionem, delectum ci-borū, & corporis, imprimis autem ani, lotio-nes vti necessarias ad salutem retinent & ob-seruant, cum Ebionitis. Azoa.12, & 16. 12 Iu-rant per creaturas veluti per ficum, & ficctum, item per oliuetū, cum Priscillianistis. 13 Bel-la pro sola religionis causa, & vt inuiti homines cogantur suscipere ipsorum dogma, geri opor-tere docent. Azoa.6.7.18, & 19. 14 Matrimonij sanctam institutionem tollunt, profanant, & polluunt: pluresque cuique vxores habere con-cedunt. Diuortia extra causas verbo Dei ex-pressas fieri concedunt, Azoa.8, & 9. 15 Operum merita inducunt, per quæ se saluos fore sperant, cum Pelagianis. Azoa.18, & 41. Itaque varias ceremonias habent, & diuersas vitæ ra-tiones, velut monachismos quosdam instituit, & obseruat. 16 Deficientibus à fide ipsorum veniam cum Nouatianis in perpetuum dene-gant. 17 Peccata alia mortalia, alia venialia constituunt. Azoa.10. 18 Orandum omnino versus Orientem docent, vt sit Deo accepta

page.notes: Page is a single column of running text with inline numbers 8 to 18 and inline Azoa references; these are kept as printed. Line-end hyphens in the scan (O-, expli-, cere-, lotio-, ob-, Iu-, Bel-, opor-, con-, ex-, ra-, dene-, Epicu-, Purgatorii-, ci-, Purgatorii-) are kept. The word "Matrimo-nij" is printed with a break and is written whole as Matrimonij. Some words are faint and "fixerūt", "ficum", "ficctum" and "Azoa.ii." are the closest readings. Long s is written as plain s throughout. The faint marks at bottom left and lower centre are not printed text and are omitted.
